rival.derby: the Derby of the Eternal Enemies

coldOpen.line: In 1906 a runner from Canada won the marathon in Athens with a green shamrock on his shirt.
coldOpen.reveal: Twelve years later a Panathinaikos player, Michalis Papazoglou, proposed the shamrock as the club's emblem — and it has been there since 1918. Many say the marathon runner gave him the idea.
coldOpen.narrate: the 1918 emblem and Papazoglou are fact; the Sherring inspiration is told as 'many say'

beats.line: Founded in 1908 by Giorgos Kalafatis — the oldest of the big Athens clubs.

beats.rule: Warzycha is the club's record scorer — sourced; 'typhoon' is not a sourced nickname

beats.line: Gate 13, the stand at Leoforos where the most devoted supporters gather.

ownerResearchCheck.claim: Papazoglou flew to Canada and brought the shamrock in a suitcase
ownerResearchCheck.verdict: wrong — the Canadian (Billy Sherring) came to Athens for the 1906 marathon; Papazoglou proposed the shamrock in 1918; the link is told as legend

ownerResearchCheck.claim: Gate 13 founded 1966, the oldest in Greece
ownerResearchCheck.verdict: plausible, not yet sourced here — narrate 'one of the oldest' until a source is added
